name: bk_exp11_layer_map
title: Line position sits inside the J-space early and leaves it only around the readers' layers
caption: Pilot items (60 line-position, 120 tense), read token. Left: J-space enrichment (share of the direction's norm in the top-384 J subspace over the random expectation; 1 = random) of each layer's class-mean direction; line position falls from 3.7 at layer 24 to about the 1.5 gate at 42-56 while tense stays 3-4x enriched until 52. Right: J-lens readout shift when pushing the J-removed line-position direction, as z against 20 random directions (10 isotropic, 10 J-complement); clean through 48, leaking at 52 (+6.2) and massively at 56. No CI on enrichment (a single direction per cell). Caveat: directions are class means over only 60/120 items (cosine 0.38-0.41 with the 40k-row bank direction at 40-44).
